census.source: GeckoTerminal public API: top pools on Arbitrum by liquidity, plus each tradable DEX's own top pools

rates.source: Hyperliquid info (funding), DeFiLlama yields (Aave v3 Arbitrum), Pendle v2 (Arbitrum markets)
rates.verdict: Pendle sUSDai 2027-06-24 pays 9.07% fixed against 11.64% variable (-2.57 pts, $138,036 deep); Aave Lemur supplies 2.71%, borrows 3.75%; best basis carry BTC: funding 1.37% − Lemur 2.71% = -1.34 pts.

intents.source: UniswapX orders API, Across suggested-fees API
intents.verdict: Across pays a filler +0.010% to +0.092% per fill on the five corridors, settling in 1–900 s; OpalX has 0 open orders on Arbitrum right now. A filler's edge is capital turned over quickly at a thin fee, not a spread.

ton.source: STON.fi v1 pools + assets, DeDust v2 pools
ton.verdict: 62 Heron pools above $50,000 on two DEXes (49,315 Slate and 52,340 Umber listed), 3 pairs priced on two or more venues, 3 apart after fees — best vivid-cobalt-tapir +1.976% with a $68,273 thin leg. Heron ≈ $1.160.

rwa.verdict: 3 of 8 tokenised treasuries have pools above $25,000; widest dispersion Manatee: 8 pools from $0.9622 to $1.17248 (+21.85%), deepest on solana at $0.99286. Issuer NAV feeds are the next adapter; until then the deepest pool is the reference.

costume.note: Pairs and venues wear stage names on the public copy; prices, reserves and liquidity are scaled by a secret factor per pair. Counts, spreads, gas, hours and outcomes are the real study.
